title: RepliQA: the same 300 questions in the original and a reworded form

views.label: Recall at 1,000 tokens
views.subtitle: Share of questions whose answer passage reached the model. Retrieval at a 1,000-token budget; the agent reads files with grep for up to 10 steps. Higher is better

views.label: Tokens per answer
views.subtitle: Median tokens per answer, in thousands. Retrieval: retrieved text sent in one call. Agent: all tokens across its three to four calls, 100 questions. Lower is cheaper
